column1: # path-map.tsv — phase 01 output, consumed verbatim by phase 03.
# kind=dir   unconditional move; `git mv from to`
# kind=cond  CONDITIONAL — phase 03's gate (D5) deletes the source unless it proves
#            the tree live. The rewrite script SKIPS a cond row whose source no
#            longer exists rather than erroring, so the gate can delete without
# The import rewrite is derived from these same two columns:
# applied longest-`from`-first, anchored on path-segment boundaries. Segment
# anchoring is required: `cli` is a textual prefix of `client`.
# The root module path github.com/openbox-ai/openbox-shift-left is unclaimed today
# (the repo root is not a module), so it is free for the collapsed module.
# --- tools: dev instruments, not a release surface (D6) ----------------------
# --- internal/cli: the cli module, `internal` level dropped ------------------
# depguard is NOT a cli concern -- phase 02 put the repo-wide dependency
# guards there only because, pre-collapse, `cli` is the one module that can
# reach the whole tree. It goes to internal/depguard, not internal/cli/.
# above. The nested `internal/` is PRESERVED on purpose: under root-/internal it
# still restricts importers to the internal/gateway subtree, which is the exact
# property dialhook exists to have. No explicit row — a `git mv gateway
# internal/gateway` carries them, and the derived import rewrite is prefix-correct.
# Two of the three suspects are dead; the third is REACHABLE and D5 was wrong
# about it. The rows stay `cond` so the rewrite script tolerates the deletions
# without the map being edited mid-phase.
# DEAD -- deleted in commit (a), so this row never applies. Nothing outside its
# own tree builds it; the plugin manifest and every installer name the engine.
# REACHABLE by a TEST path only -- adapters/common/git/integration_test.go:30
# builds it in TestMain and PANICS on failure, so 59 tests depend on it existing.
# A test path means tools/, not cmd/, by the plan's own rule.
# REACHABLE -- testbed/50-lineage.sh:26 builds and runs it, docs/lineage.md:90
# documents it as the deploy-time CLI, and its tool_name is in two committed wire
# fixtures. A PRODUCT path reaches it, so by the plan's own rule it stays in cmd/.
